name: Commander Dhamaka
description: a short round pumpkin-shaped Pixar-style 3D alien commander, glossy orange skin, a large forehead with a glowing ruby-red gem in the centre, two small furious black eyes under thick bushy eyebrows, two long curly whisker-feelers curling upward like a filmi villain's moustache, a black cape with a gold border, stubby legs and tiny hands
voice: booming theatrical filmi-villain baritone, Hindi, that cracks into a flustered squeak when he is embarrassed
signature: spreads both arms wide and shouts 'Ab hoga DHAMAKA!', then nothing happens
props: a chunky silver ray gun (per shot, not part of the frozen description)
doNot: no hat or helmet (except the mind-control helmet-cannon in E08)
no English dialogue beyond 'Good Morning' and 'delete'
never insults Chintu or Bhondu with level-2 words

images.anchor: not yet generated. Generate in Gemini using prompts.md, accept one, then set frozen to true.

notes: Gem colour is the status bar: red = angry and powerful, pink = happy and weak, blue-white = calm and truly powerful (E14 only). Describe the gem colour in every prompt.
